definition: Concurrent estates are estates that are either owned or possessed by two or more individuals simultaneously. Concurrent estates include tenancy in common, joint tenancy, and tenancy by the entirety See: Tkachik v. Mandeville, 487 Mich. 38, 790 N.W.2d 260 (Mich. 2010), and Holbrook v. Holbrook 240 Or. 567 (1965)
